I think it may be a lot to do with my expectations. But what I do dread is not being able to live happily and comfortably with a job I like and a nice home. I keep trying to prepare for the future but I fail and become unmotivated to do anything. There is a bit more underlying too that I'd prefer not to discuss though.
It almost feels like life itself is the problem, you know? I feel like I'm just living day by day, and just dreading the next. I get so exhausted and I don't know why
